targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "execution_time" and r._field == "exec_ms" and r.status == "completed" and r.model_key =~ /${model_key:regex}/ and r.service =~ /${service:regex}/ and r.environment =~ /${environment:regex}/ and (not exists r.api_key or r.api_key =~ /${api_key:regex}/) and (not exists r.email or r.email =~ /${email:regex}/))
  |> group()
  |> quantile(q: 0.95)

from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "execution_time" and r._field == "exec_ms" and r.status == "completed" and r.model_key =~ /${model_key:regex}/ and r.service =~ /${service:regex}/ and r.environment =~ /${environment:regex}/ and (not exists r.api_key or r.api_key =~ /${api_key:regex}/) and (not exists r.email or r.email =~ /${email:regex}/))
  |> group()
  |> quantile(q: 0.5)

panels.title: Execution time p95 by model
panels.description: Pure model execution latency (successful runs), per model.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "execution_time" and r._field == "exec_ms" and r.status == "completed" and r.model_key =~ /${model_key:regex}/ and r.service =~ /${service:regex}/ and r.environment =~ /${environment:regex}/ and (not exists r.api_key or r.api_key =~ /${api_key:regex}/) and (not exists r.email or r.email =~ /${email:regex}/))
  |> group(columns: ["model_key"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column), createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Phase latency p95 by status

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "status_time" and r._field == "duration_ms" and r.model_key =~ /${model_key:regex}/ and r.service =~ /${service:regex}/ and r.environment =~ /${environment:regex}/ and (not exists r.api_key or r.api_key =~ /${api_key:regex}/) and (not exists r.email or r.email =~ /${email:regex}/))
